svg.title: Rockaway nearshore depths
svg.desc: Map of the Rockaway Beach shore, turned so the beach runs across with the ocean below, with depth contours from 2 to 40 feet, 51 jetties, the boardwalk and labelled street ends. Depths in feet below mean lower low water. Surveyed May 2023 (47% of the surf zone); older parts 2009, 2013 and 2017. Not for navigation. Sandbars move with every storm; this is a snapshot, not today's bottom.

text.font-family: 'Instrument Serif', 'Instrument Serif Fallback', 'Times New Roman', Times, serif
